security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, and a public Next.js environment variable example. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, command execution path, or malicious behavior was found in SKILL.md or reference.md.

remediation.issue: Markdown code spans triggered command execution rules.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples in clearly labeled fenced blocks and avoid ambiguous shell-like syntax when possible.
State that example.com, myapp.com, and schema.org values are placeholders or standard metadata contexts.

remediation.issue: The robots.ts example uses process.env for a public app URL.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that only NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is required and that secrets must never be exposed in metadata or sitemap output.

content.value_statement: Search visibility fails when routes, metadata, and structured data are inconsistent. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Next.js SEO updates.
actual_capabilities: Guides updates to Next.js sitemap files for static routes and large URL sets.
Explains layout and page metadata patterns for titles, descriptions, and OpenGraph images.
Provides next-seo and raw script approaches for JSON-LD structured data.
Recommends ISR and generateStaticParams patterns for content-heavy pages.
Shows robots.txt configuration for crawl rules and sitemap URLs.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not a live SEO audit.
It focuses on Next.js App Router patterns, not every web framework.
Placeholder domains and sample data must be replaced before production use.
Search ranking results still depend on content quality, links, and indexing behavior.

use_cases.title: Add Launch Page SEO
use_cases.description: Create metadata, sitemap entries, and crawler rules for new public pages before release.

use_cases.title: Improve Content Indexing
use_cases.description: Apply ISR, structured data, and page metadata to blogs, docs, and marketing content.

use_cases.title: Standardize SEO Reviews
use_cases.description: Use consistent checks for OpenGraph, JSON-LD, robots.txt, and sitemap coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Check a New Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my new Next.js public page for sitemap, metadata, OpenGraph, and robots.txt requirements. List the changes I should make.

prompt_templates.title: Create Metadata Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a metadata plan for these Next.js pages. Include title templates, descriptions, canonical URLs, and OpenGraph image guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Add Structured Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend JSON-LD structured data for these content pages. Explain whether next-seo components or a raw script tag fit best.

prompt_templates.title: Audit SEO Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Next.js App Router SEO architecture. Cover sitemap splitting, ISR, generateStaticParams, robots.txt, metadata inheritance, and schema coverage.

output_examples.input: A new marketing page needs SEO coverage before launch.
output_examples.output: The response lists required metadata, the sitemap entry, suggested OpenGraph fields, and crawler visibility checks.

output_examples.input: A blog section has many dynamic posts and slow indexing.
output_examples.output: The response recommends ISR settings, generated static parameters, batched sitemaps, and article structured data.

output_examples.input: A product page needs richer search result eligibility.
output_examples.output: The response identifies suitable structured data fields, image requirements, canonical URL handling, and validation steps.

best_practices: Keep every public route represented in the sitemap or a generated sitemap batch.
Set default metadata in layouts and override page-specific values close to the route.
Validate structured data and crawler rules before publishing production pages.
anti_patterns: Do not expose private routes, admin paths, or secret data through metadata or sitemaps.
Do not reuse generic titles and descriptions across many indexed pages.
Do not publish placeholder domains, sample images, or incomplete structured data.

faq.question: Does this skill run an SEO crawler?
faq.answer: No. It gives implementation guidance for Next.js SEO files and page patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with dynamic sitemap generation?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes sitemap splitting and batched generation for large URL sets.

faq.question: Does it support JSON-LD structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers next-seo components and raw script tag patterns for unsupported schemas.

faq.question: Is it only for Next.js?
faq.answer: The examples and file paths target Next.js App Router projects.

faq.question: Can it improve search rankings by itself?
faq.answer: No. It improves technical SEO readiness, but ranking depends on content, links, and search engine behavior.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
